content:
Tara: heads-up: deploybot aborted promote for release/2026-03-25 due to container layer checksum flip during staging pulls. Change window in ~45m. tagging @ben @anya for triage + decision.

deploybot: Promotion aborted at 1719009876. Reason: pulled layer digest mismatch. Manifest references sha256:44aa but pulled layer reports sha256:77bb. Job: ci/staging/smoke#834. Logs: https://ci.internal/ci/834 (internal).

Ben: I reproduced locally: the registry returned a different blob for that digest intermittently. Saw 502s from the storage gateway right before the publish. Could be multipart finalize race with GC.

Anya: product prefers minimal risk. Options: 1) pin to prod image sha256:prod999 (fast), 2) delay window 30m to attempt re-publish + mirror sync. Which do we prefer?

Tara: pinning is lowest blast radius. But if mirror has correct blobs we can delay and rehydrate. Timebox 30m?

ops-bot: Registry GC ran at 1719009600. Mirror sync schedule: every 10m, next at 1719010200.

Ben: I'll pause GC and kick a mirror rehydrate for the repo prefix. If mirror reports blobs present we can rerun two fast canaries. If mirror missing, fallback to pin.

Anya: set a hard cutoff at +30m. If still failing then pin and open INFR-4055. Notify support/product.

Tara: agreed. @deploybot put the promote on hold until 1719011876 (30m).

deploybot: Promotion placed on hold until 1719011876 per reason 'hold-rehydrate-after-checksum-flip'. Will auto-abort at cutoff.

Ben: kicked rehydrate: `infra mirror rehydrate --prefix services/webapp --since 1719009000`. Watching copy logs.

ops-bot: mirror rehydrate progress: 35% at 1719009960, 100% at 1719010205.

Ben: started two fast canaries. ci/staging/canary#835 passed, canary#836 passed. Starting acceptance.

Anya: acceptance running. If green, we proceed. Also please add a short release note: "promotion briefly delayed to rehydrate missing layers after registry GC; promoted after mirror sync; follow-up INFR-4055."

Tara: acceptance passed. Proceeding with promote to prod pinned image sha256:prod999 per fallback plan (we decided to keep prod image consistent while we fully verify the newly republished artifact).

deploybot: Promotion complete. prod now at sha256:prod999. Promotion timestamp: 1719010260.

Tara: opening INFR-4055 with timeline, logs, `skopeo inspect` outputs, and recommended mitigations: pre-promote HEAD/digest checks in deploybot, guard in GC to avoid finalizing uploads published in last 10m, and increase mirror priority during publishes. Assigning to Ben.

Ben: will PR changes to deploybot and GC guard today. Also adding a short smoke that validates blob digests post-publish.

Anya: thanks all, updating change calendar and messaging stakeholders. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
